name: samples-basic
notes: The child's validation suite over the `samples` stream (ADR-0015): structure-level rules producing failing COUNTS; error rules can block a publish, warn NEVER blocks. Runs against any acquired snapshot: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-sample.json --snapshot <vid>. The sample stream is in-code JSON, so `value` arrives as a real number and in_range works directly — a CSV-backed source would need a cast first (stdlib csv does not guess types).

rules.notes: An empty pull is a broken connector, not a quiet day. Raise min to your expected floor.
Nulls in the field downstream work depends on. Loosen with error_if '> 10' to tolerate a known-dirty tail.
An out-of-band value is worth a look, not a blocked publish — warn never blocks (the dbt threshold model).
